title: Advanced CSS
description: Modern layout and design systems: Grid and Flexbox together, custom properties and theming, animations and transitions, responsive design with container queries.
prerequisites: The CSS foundations course: selectors, the box model, basic Flexbox and Grid.
youWillBuild: A dashboard layout, a themeable component library with dark mode, motion-safe animations, and cards that adapt to whatever slot they are placed in.
overview: Learn the CSS that powers real dApp interfaces: two-dimensional layouts, design tokens with custom properties, performant motion, and components that respond to their container instead of the viewport.
